description: Call this before your agent pays an unfamiliar x402 payTo address or endpoint. Checks public sanctions lists (OFAC SDN crypto addresses), the ScamSniffer scam list, on-chain wallet age, activity and program status on Solana or Base, and optionally the endpoint's unpaid 402 challenge (payTo mismatch, price outliers). Returns verdict ok, caution, do_not_pay or unknown, a 0-100 score, flags with evidence, and missing_fields. Unknown is never reported as safe. If every source is unreachable the call returns HTTP 502 and you are not charged. Part of the agent spend firewall bundle (payee_check + seller_report + pretrade); see /.well-known/x402 bundles. Costs $0.0045 USDC (4500 base units) via x402. The same price is charged for HTTP GET /payee/check. An unpaid HTTP call returns 402 even when the query is missing or invalid. A signed call with invalid arguments is rejected before settlement and is not charged. A successful result can set cached, stale, and cacheAgeMs. stale true means a previous result was served while a refresh runs or the upstream failed. You are charged only when the tool result is not an error.
name: payee_check
